description: EIOPA publishes the Data Point Model (DPM) and XBRL taxonomies that insurers and pension funds use, through national supervisors, to submit supervisory reports to the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority, following decisions of its Board of Supervisors on the collection of information and on reporting for the pan-European Personal Pension Product. The page lists the releases in production, such as Solvency II minor release 2.8.2, optional hotfix releases for the NACE 2.1 industry classification, and notes that support for XBRL canonical files ended, with users asked to use the zipped taxonomy packages instead by 31 December 2025. It is produced by EIOPA. Coverage is insurance and occupational pension reporting in the European Union. The taxonomy packages are available free to download; the page read gives no reuse licence. Caveats: these are reporting specifications, not insurer data, and NACE 2.1 codes must be mapped back to NACE 2.0 under current releases. For simulation it documents the structure of Solvency II supervisory data, so that models of insurance resilience to disasters can read reported exposures correctly. It is related to the EBA reporting frameworks record in this catalogue, the banking counterpart.
